summary: The TotalYearType class manages year-related data, including term information, current and next terms, and expiration lists. It offers static methods to fetch various year and term lists like certification expiry and N95 mask fit test dates.
purpose: To provide utility methods for managing year-specific data like academic terms and certification details.

workflows.name: Get Current and Next Term
steps: Calculate and return the current and next academic term based on today's date.

conditions.description: Determine current academic term based on the date.
conditions.logic: Date-based comparison to determine if today falls in Winter, SpringSummer, or Fall.

system_behavior.description: Provides methods to fetch and format year-specific data.

summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin module handles the administrative interface for staff. It includes components such as site and discipline dropdowns, last login tracking, and error/warning panels.
purpose: To provide an administrative interface for staff to manage site profiles and other related data.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Setup page components including last login details.
Fill dropdowns for site and discipline.

validations.description: Validate that the start date is before the end date.

system_behavior.description: The module handles page rendering, dropdown population, and refreshes data based on user inputs.

summary: ServiceCode manages service-related codes for courses and timetables, allowing for retrieval of service codes using various list methods.
purpose: To manage and retrieve service codes related to courses and timetables.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Execute database procedure to fetch service codes based on given parameters.

system_behavior.description: Fetches and localizes service codes for different sessions and courses.

summary: SiteProfileHistory handles logging and retrieval of site profile changes. It tracks modifications by different users and provides formatted views for display.
purpose: To manage and display history of changes to site profiles.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: Execute database procedure to fetch site profile history based on site ID and session agency ID.

system_behavior.description: Maintains and formats user actions on site profiles for historical viewing.

summary: EmailPopupDocument manages email-related document entries, including searching and deleting documents from a given dataset.
purpose: To handle document entries related to emails, providing methods to search and delete documents.

workflows.name: Search and Delete Email Documents
steps: Search documents based on input string.
Delete a document and its folder if it matches the given ID.

system_behavior.description: Provides functionality to manage email documents and their deletion.
